what.text: This page follows refugees from Colombia living in Panama, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1630 Colombian refugees in Panama, 2.0% of all refugees from Colombia.
Ecuador hosts the most Colombian refugees, followed by Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 1991 to 2025, with the ELN and FARC groups among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2007 to 2016, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 7 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 15957, at the end of 2013, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Panama.
These are year-end totals for Panama only, reported to UNHCR.
